text: The paragraph contributes to the plot's development by establishing the inciting incident and the central conflict of the narrative. The event of the spaceship hurtling through the wormhole serves as the catalyst that moves the characters from their known reality into an unknown setting. This transition leads directly to the discovery of an advanced galaxy, which functions as the new status quo. The mention of "first contact" introduces the core dramatic tension, framing the subsequent plot around the dual possibilities of cooperation and conflict, thereby setting the stakes for the story's future developments.
